intro.heading:
Hi, I’m Liliia — viral
content creator & founder of UGC Kids
paragraphs: Together with my 5-year-old daughter (on camera since she was 2!), we produce family-driven UGC that feels warm, authentic, and relatable — and that’s why it actually delivers results.
For over 3 years, I’ve been mastering content & marketing — from storytelling and emotional hooks to platform algorithms.
That’s why our videos aren’t just “cute” — they’re built to perform.
Authentic short-form UGC that builds trust, sparks engagement, and keeps audiences coming back.
👩‍👧 Mother + child production — a unique format perfect for family & kids brands.
📈 Millions of organic views across campaigns (and growing every day).
✨ Story-driven scripts with clean visuals and natural pacing — fully optimized for Reels & TikTok.

What you get:
• Videos people save, share, and ask for product links in the comments
• Native, lifestyle content that feels warm, real, and relatable
• Flexible production packages (from single videos to bundles)
• Option to publish on my own channels to reach moms & families directly
